'''Plop Dribble's''' was a spaceport restaurant on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]], which was owned by [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo]]. [[Marwigo/Legends|Marwigo]] and [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]] were waitresses there.

==History==
[[File:PlopDribbles-Brothers.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The interior of the diner]]
[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] stopped at Plop Dribble's on his quest to find [[Darth Maul/Legends|his brother]]. When one of the waitresses, [[Marwigo/Legends|Marwigo]], had difficulty in taking the mute Opress' order, she passed on the task to her fellow waitress, [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]]. However, when Sassi stopped to admire the [[Talisman of Finding/Legends|talisman]] he was wearing and reached for it, Opress choked her, nearly killing her. After he attracted the attention of other staff and patrons through his actions, he promptly fled and escaped before [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|the authorities]] arrived. Following Opress' escape, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] also coincidentally stopped to dine at the establishment, but not before attempting to investigate the assault on Sassi.
